text:
Vanessa Ortiz: heads up — we’re targeting the customer pilot expansion window this week. Need to lock: (1) exact window, (2) who’s monitoring each stage, (3) comms draft + escalation path.

Vanessa Ortiz: proposal is Thu 21:00–23:00 PT (Fri 05:00–07:00 UTC). This lines up w/ customer maintenance window from CS, and gives us US + EU coverage. Any objections?

Harish Reddy: works for Fleet Ops. I can be primary for running the pipeline + hands-on interventions. Prefer starting 20:30 PT so we can do prechecks before the customer window opens.

Rafael Mendes: SRE ok w/ Thu. We should be explicit that routing will *not* advertise this pool until Ready, so customer impact should be none unless they’re watching the console. I’ll be on for the window + 30m after.

Lauren Bishop: +1 to Thu. Please make sure we have a crisp update template for CS: “what we’re doing / what changes / what could go wrong / how we’ll know it’s done”.

Connor O'Brien: release side: if we’re enabling the feature flag in prod for this run, I want a go/no-go check at T-60m. Also confirm rollback = disable flag + revert to manual provisioning flow (no routing exposure).

Miles Thornton: can someone confirm region + SKU for this expansion? if it’s the same region that had slow imaging last week, we should prewarm the artifact mirror or at least have the fallback ready.

Jamal Pierce: from capacity planning notes this is us-east + H100 80GB. Same region as the imaging slowness thread but different SKU than last time.

Vanessa Ortiz: ok. assigning roles:
- Pipeline operator / stage control: @Harish Reddy
- SRE monitoring + paging decisions: @Rafael Mendes
- Dashboard + metrics sanity check: @Aisha Bello
- Comms coordinator (CS-facing): @Lauren Bishop (please loop in CS directly; we’ll provide draft)
- Release/flag gate + rollback tracking: @Connor O'Brien
- Infra backup / multi-region reviewer: @Miles Thornton

Aisha Bello: works. I’ll monitor time-to-ready dashboard + stage histograms + error rate panels. Please make sure the pool/customer variables are populated for the new pool id once we have it.

Kira Thompson: I can own the runbook checklist + “what to do if stuck” copy/paste for the thread. Drop links you want included.

Vanessa Ortiz: links:
- readiness dashboard (staging layout, prod is same): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/dedicated-readiness-dashboard
- provisioning runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/dedicated-pool-provisioning-runbook
- control plane ready-state troubleshooting: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/control-plane-ready-troubleshooting

Vanessa Ortiz: comms draft (CS -> customer) below, pls edit:

---
Subject: Dedicated capacity expansion — scheduled readiness validation window

Hi <Customer Team>,

We’re scheduled to complete the final provisioning + readiness validation for your Dedicated capacity expansion during the following window:
- Thu <DATE> 21:00–23:00 PT (Fri <DATE> 05:00–07:00 UTC)

What to expect:
- We will provision and validate the additional GPU capacity and run automated health + performance checks (networking/TLS, GPU health, runtime smoke test, lightweight perf canary).
- Your existing Dedicated traffic will continue to run on your current capacity. The new capacity will not be added to routing until it passes readiness gates.

How we’ll confirm completion:
- We will send an update once the pool is marked “Ready” in the control plane and the capacity is actively serving traffic.

If anything unexpected occurs:
- We will keep the new capacity out of routing, roll back to the previous stable state, and provide an ETA for the next attempt.

Best,
Redwood Inference Team
---

Lauren Bishop: looks good. I’ll add 1 line clarifying “no downtime expected” + “we’ll post progress every ~30 min”.

Rafael Mendes: escalation path (internal) suggestion:
- If any stage is stuck > 20 min beyond expected stage budget OR repeated failures: post in this thread + tag @Rafael Mendes + @Harish Reddy
- If customer impact suspected (unexpected 5xx on existing pool): page SRE oncall immediately + post to #incidents
- If security/provenance/signing failure: tag @Marcus Lin (sec) before attempting workaround

Harish Reddy: prechecks I want by T-30m:
- confirm quota + IAM ok
- confirm image artifact available in region (or mirror fallback ready)
- confirm helm chart versions pinned (no “latest”)
- dry-run of `fleetctl provision --pool <id> --dry-run` and validate config schema passes

Connor O'Brien: can we formalize go/no-go at T-60m in thread? checklist:
1) feature flag enabled only for target pool
2) dashboards green / no ongoing incident
3) operators present
4) rollback owner confirmed

Vanessa Ortiz: yes. We’ll do a T-60m checkpoint in this same thread.

Aisha Bello: alerting behavior for pilot: I’d prefer NOT paging on first failure. Create ticket + slack notification unless customer impact. Paging only if stuck stage persists >45m or repeated failures >3 attempts.

Rafael Mendes: agreed. I’ll handle paging decisions during the window.

Miles Thornton: re imaging fallback: if we see slow pulls, switch to mirror `artifact-mirror-02` (runbook has the env var). Please confirm that’s allowed in prod for this customer.

Harish Reddy: it’s allowed. I’ll keep it as “break glass” and note it in the audit log.

Kira Thompson: I’ll update the runbook snippet for this pilot w/ the escalation + mirror fallback steps and paste here before Thu.

Vanessa Ortiz: final: locking window Thu 21:00–23:00 PT. I’ll send CS the comms draft + internal roles. Please keep this thread as the single source of truth during the window (stage updates + links). (reactions: :thumbsup: from Rafael Mendes, Lauren Bishop, Connor O'Brien, Harish Reddy)
